Description
PAMP Suisse, or Produits Artistiques Metaux Precieux (Artistic, Precious Metal Products), is the world’s leading precious metal refiner and one of the most trusted and certified precious metal refiners and fabricators. This newly designed 1 oz Pamp Suisse Lakshmi Gold Bar contains 1 troy oz of .9999 fine gold and is manufactured in Switzerland.
The Lakshmi  Gold Bar is one of the five bars to be released as a part of the PAMP Suisse Gold series, each uniquely designed in celebration of different religious figures, monuments, and icons. Each Gold Bar is individually registered and sealed in a protective case, along with an official “Assay Certificate” that certifies the purity, weight, and gold content of the item.
Design of  1 oz PAMP Suisse – Lakshmi Gold Bar (New w/ Assay)
The obverse side of the 1 oz PAMP Suisse Gold Bar – Lakshmi depicts the Hindu Goddess Lakshmi i.e the goddess of wealth, love, prosperity, and the embodiment of beauty. Her four hands stand for dharma, kama, artha, and
moksha
, the four aims of human life that the Hindu way of life considers proper. Archaeological finds and ancient coins indicate that the goddess Lakshmi was honored and revered. Lakshmi’s iconography and sculptures have been discovered in Hindu temples in Southeast Asia, estimated to be from the second millennium AD. Lakshmi is today revered as the goddess of money. In her honor, the festivals of Diwali and Sharad Purnima are observed.
A picture of the PAMP Suisse emblem, as well as other distinguishing markers, can be found on the reverse face of these 1 oz PAMP Suisse Lakshmi Gold Bars. The PAMP logo is shown at the top of the design area, with the remaining markings arranged vertically down the bar’s face. Other labels on the bar include the weight, purity, metal content, and serial number. Serial numbers for this series are as follows: A one-letter, six-number code is used to identify serial numbers in this sequence.
Main Highlights of PAMP Suisse 1 oz Gold Bar-Lakshmi
Contains 1 troy oz of .9999 fine Gold.
Produced by the PAMP Sussie
Each Gold bar comes with its own assay card for authentication.
Eligible for Precious Metal IRAs.
Features the depiction of Hindu Goddess Lakshmi on the obverse.
Features the depiction of PAMP Suisse Logo, weight, and purity along with a unique serial number on the reverse.
Each bar is assigned a unique serial number
